about_the_game:
• STORY :

High school student Lin Meng planned to travel and relax during the summer vacation to celebrate her admission to college. She accidentally discovered a place called "Seagull Island" on social media and found it very beautiful. So she took a small boat alone to this place. On the first day of landing, she found that the residents and tourists on the island were gone. It wasn't until she saw a bulletin board that she realized she had accidentally entered another space. Unexpectedly, this would be the beginning of a nightmare ..

  • PLAYING METHOD :

This is a third tier shooting game that includes lightweight horror elements, appropriate puzzle solving elements, and a small amount of action elements;

So, the difficulty is not very high, making it a shooting horror game suitable for beginners to get started with, without worrying about being overly scared ..

  • CHARACTERISTIC :

The entire game revolves around an isolated island, with forests, secret rooms, research institutes, and scenes similar to a back room. Each scene has its own unique characteristics, exploring unknown areas and integrating classic third person shooting modes for a more immersive experience. You can find weapons to knock down enemies, find keys to solve puzzles, and escape from difficulties, step by step approaching the truth ..

content_descriptors.notes: There will be some scenes of shooting enemies in the game..
